rationale: This is a post-blowoff distribution phase on an extreme low-float micro-cap — price collapsed ~48% off the $10.84 high, then went dead flat, with the last five 5-minute candles chopping in a 13-cent range on volume that has dried to a tiny fraction of the morning's pace, offering no directional commitment in either direction. With 30 minutes to close, inconsistent VWAP data, an N/A borrow on a 1.03M-share float (shorting carries squeeze/locate risk), and equal ambiguity between a breakdown below $5.23 and a relief bounce, neither entry has a measurable edge. Standing aside is the highest-expectation action.
